# Sink benchmark v1.1

This immutable dataset extends the v1 contract with balanced file-backed HTTP
payload cases in both development and validation.

- every split still covers positive and negative Bash, MCP, and final-answer cases;
- file-backed cases use only static `--data-binary @relative-file` syntax;
- public file bodies are explicit synthetic workspace fixtures;
- all fixture bodies are excluded from benchmark reports;
- the production Hook policy is not enabled by this evaluation dataset.
